Millbrook’s population increased from 34,590 to 37,203, a growth factor of 37,203 ÷ 34,590. Applying the same percentage growth to 2025:

37,203 × (37,203 ÷ 34,590) ≈ 40,011 residents.

This exceeds 40,000.

ANSWER: yes | 40011
